item.title: 'The smiling coast': Rotary delegation returns from Gambian trip
item.description: After an eye-opening trip to The Gambia last month, local service club delegates hope to continue their collaboration, as well as their new friendships. Fate played a role in making the journey to the small west African country a reality, according to Rotary Club of Chatham Sunrise’s Glenn Smith, past-president and current treasurer. item.title: Blenheim’s Breanne Nicholas owns Canadian rugby sevens record
item.description: Blenheim’s Breanne Nicholas is now alone in the Canadian rugby record book for having more caps than any women’s sevens player.

item.description: Residents are invited to help pick the site of a new community garden in Chatham-Kent. item.title: Local roundup: All-Stars stay on ballot; Barnstormers sign slugger; Josling eighth
item.description: The Chatham Coloured All-Stars stay on the Canadian Baseball Hall of Fame ballot for the veterans committee "forever or until they are inducted," operations director Scott Crawford says.

item.title: Provincial Junior Hockey League regular season enters final week
